description: Parse an Authorization header value into its scheme and credentials. `Basic` is base64-decoded into username/password, `Bearer` returns the token as-is, and any other scheme (Digest, OAuth, custom) is parsed as comma-separated `key=value` / `key="value"` parameters.

header.description: The Authorization header value to parse, e.g. "Bearer eyJ..." or "Basic YWxpY2U6..."

name: parse_authorization_header
